spec.title: Table spec (JSON)
spec.description: JSON describing the ranked table: optional title/subtitle, a 'badges' array (label, variant), an optional summary callout (showSummary, summaryTitle, summaryDetail), a 'columns' array (key, header, align[start|end|center]) and a 'rows' array (each row has an optional 'id' plus a value per column key), optional 'highlights' (iconName, iconColor, title, detail) and an optional CTA (ctaLabel, ctaUrl). Leave blank to render a portable demo pipeline.
